title: Crowfoot Wrench at 90 Degrees
introduction:
A crowfoot gives the torque wrench an open-ended reach into an awkward spot. I use this drawing as a positioning guide: the crowfoot projects sideways from the wrench head, making an L with the handle. Match the angle shown before tightening, then use the fastener specification in the workshop manual.

This reference explains the illustrated tool arrangement. The fastener’s own procedure still supplies its tightening specification and any preparation or replacement requirements.

items.name: Fastener specification
items.detail: Have the workshop-manual specification for the particular fastener available.

items.name: Tool arrangement
items.detail: Use the crowfoot and torque wrench in the arrangement shown in the illustration.
